concepts.title: Definition of Integers
concepts.definition: Counting numbers, their signed mirrors, and zero together make up the integers.
concepts.key_idea: The number line marches both ways from 0: ... -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3 ...
question_patterns: Are the mirror numbers of the counting numbers integers too?

solution_steps.explain: Check if the number is a whole number, a negative of a whole number, or zero.

solution_steps.action: Place the number on the number line
solution_steps.explain: Every integer has a fixed position to the left or right of zero

solution_steps.action: Confirm membership in the integer set
solution_steps.explain: if it is a counting number, the negative of a counting number, or zero, it belongs to the set of integers

concepts.title: Positive and Negative Numbers
concepts.definition: A plus in front marks a number as positive, a minus in front marks it as negative; zero alone is neither.
concepts.key_idea: The sign records direction from zero: right side positive, left side negative.
question_patterns: identify the sign of the number
Is zero positive, negative, or neither?
What sign marks a number as below zero?

solution_steps.explain: Look for + or - symbols; if no symbol is present on a non-zero number, it is usually positive.

solution_steps.action: Locate the number relative to zero
solution_steps.explain: positive numbers sit to the right of zero, negative numbers to the left
zero is neither positive nor negative; it is the reference point on the number line

concepts.title: Additive Inverse
concepts.definition: Pair a number with the partner that sums it to zero; that partner is its mirror under addition (for 5 it is -5).
concepts.key_idea: Flip the sign and the total becomes zero.
question_patterns: what number added to {n} gives zero
What is the mirror partner of -9 under addition?

solution_steps.action: Change the sign of the number
solution_steps.explain: To find the inverse, subtract the number from zero.

solution_steps.action: Verify the pair sums to zero
solution_steps.explain: adding the number and its inverse should give zero
the inverse is the mirror partner that returns the sum to zero

concepts.title: Integer Addition (Movement Model)
concepts.definition: Read a sum as a journey: from a starting floor, a movement takes you to a target floor.
concepts.key_idea: Rightward or upward motion is positive, leftward or downward motion negative.
question_patterns: you start at floor {start} and move {movement} floors, where are you
find the target position if start is {start} and movement is {movement}
You stand on floor 3 and go down 5 floors -- where are you?

solution_steps.action: Add the movement to the starting position
solution_steps.explain: The final position is the algebraic sum of the start and the change.
a positive movement moves right or up, a negative movement moves left or down
the target floor is the result of the algebraic sum on the number line

concepts.title: Integer Subtraction (Movement Model)
concepts.definition: Read a difference as a journey too: the motion needed to go from your start to the target.
concepts.key_idea: Subtracting names the trip, not just the gap.
question_patterns: find the movement needed to reach {target} from {start}
what button to press to go from {start} to {target}
Which motion takes you from floor -2 to floor 4?
Find the journey from 5 down to -3.

solution_steps.action: Subtract the starting position from the target position
solution_steps.explain: The difference represents the movement required.

solution_steps.action: Interpret the sign of the movement
solution_steps.explain: a positive result means moving right or up, a negative result means moving left or down
the movement value tells which button to press to travel from start to target

concepts.title: Comparing Integers
concepts.definition: On the number line, any number sitting further left is the smaller one.
concepts.formula: a < b if a is to the left of b
concepts.key_idea: Everything above zero beats everything below zero.
question_patterns: arrange the integers in increasing order

solution_steps.action: Locate numbers on the number line
solution_steps.explain: Negative numbers are to the left of 0, positive numbers are to the right.
The number further to the right is the greater number.
use < or > to record which number is smaller and which is greater

concepts.title: Brahmagupta's Rules for Addition
concepts.definition: Adding opposite signs? Take away the smaller size from the larger and adopt the larger one's sign; two negatives end negative.
concepts.key_idea: Same signs: add the sizes and keep the sign. Mixed signs: subtract sizes, keep the stronger.
question_patterns: what is the result of adding {a} and {b}
Add -15 and +9 using the sign rules.

solution_steps.explain: Apply the rule for same or different signs.
if both numbers share the same sign, add their sizes and keep that sign
if the signs differ, subtract the smaller size from the larger size and keep the sign of the larger number for the final sum

concepts.title: Subtraction as Addition of Inverse
concepts.definition: Taking away an integer means adding its mirror: a - b = a + (-b).
concepts.key_idea: Minus a negative turns into plus a positive.
question_patterns: Rewrite 5 - 9 as an addition and finish it.

solution_steps.action: Find the additive inverse of the subtrahend
solution_steps.explain: The inverse of b is -b.

solution_steps.action: Add the inverse to the first number
solution_steps.explain: a - b is equivalent to a + (-b).
the subtraction is complete once the addition of the inverse is evaluated

concepts.title: Token Model and Zero Pairs
concepts.definition: One plus token and one minus token wipe each other out -- the pair is worth nothing, a zero pair.
concepts.key_idea: Build sums with tokens, cancel zero pairs, and read what remains.
question_patterns: how many zero pairs are in {pos} positive and {neg} negative tokens
what is left after cancelling zero pairs
How many zero pairs hide in 6 positive and 4 negative tokens?
What remains after 3 positive and 3 negative tokens meet?

solution_steps.explain: The number of zero pairs is the minimum of the counts of positive and negative tokens.
The final value is the sum of all tokens.
after cancelling zero pairs, the remaining unpaired tokens give the final answer with their sign

concepts.title: Integers in Real World
concepts.definition: Money in, heights above the sea, temperatures above freezing go positive; money out, depths, and cold below zero go negative.
concepts.key_idea: Zero is the agreed reference: sea level, ground level, freezing point.
question_patterns: represent a debit of {val} as an integer
what is the bank balance after a credit of {c} and debit of {d}
represent a temperature of {t} degrees below zero
A submarine sits 250 m under the sea -- write that as an integer.
A debit of 400 rupees hits your account -- represent it.

solution_steps.explain: Credits/Above are +, Debits/Below are -.
sea level, ground level, or freezing point acts as zero
add all positive and negative quantities to find the final signed result
